native_input_snapshot.recipe: sort relative path strings for Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml and all *.rs in src/tests/examples; concatenate path + NUL + ASCII sha256(file) + LF; SHA-256 the concatenation

independent_review: approved; no remaining confirmed findings; source review only
revision_note: Content-addressed native source input snapshot; the Git commit containing these evidence files binds the final revision. No self-referential final commit hash is manufactured.

baseline.binary_hash_note: Baseline executable was not hashed before the shared target path was overwritten; source/adapter/log hashes are retained instead.

environment_note: Per-command environment values are retained in validation-redesign.json. CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 is the local workaround for a pinned-toolchain shared-target incremental fingerprint ICE; the pinned Rust version is unchanged. CI uses Node 24.22.0 whereas the local supported Node version was 24.19.0.

workload_semantics.measurement: real ConversationRuntime inbound -> AgentExecution -> ModelAdapter::stream(request); timestamp recorded at adapter entry
workload_semantics.timing_scope: starts immediately before native source preparation; includes candidate commit, runtime construction, activation, admission and context assembly; authored config, loopback servers and tool storage setup are outside the clock
workload_semantics.provider: scripted adapter; exactly one actual ModelRequest per row; no external provider network latency
workload_semantics.transport: real loopback Streamable HTTP; client and server share one test process; server processes are therefore exactly zero
workload_semantics.handler_count_scope: server_handler_instances counts SDK request-handler factory invocations, not physical connections or MCP sessions; handshake counts independently prove one live initialization per source
workload_semantics.first_tool_scope: first affected MCP tools/call through the captured native executor after the measured model Attempt settles; not a model-generated tool step
workload_semantics.capability_scope: terminal_capability_ready_ms includes Ready and explicit Unavailable outcomes, not successful readiness of failed sources
workload_semantics.baseline_failure_scope: a preparation rejection records startup_failure and null capability/request/Attempt timestamps with zero model requests; it is not converted into optional success by the baseline adapter
workload_semantics.fresh_repeat_scope: a separate Conversation native source owner first discovers the same endpoints/workspace with fast responses, closes its connections, and is excluded from the measured clock and request counts
workload_semantics.failed_phase: tools/list returns a protocol error after its controlled delay
workload_semantics.timing_assertions: none; exact model/tool/protocol counts and tool inventories are asserted; controlled delays are workload inputs

counts_note: Every current row has one actual model request. Each of N sources performs exactly one live handshake and one tools/list; nonempty healthy rows make one native tools/call. Peak phases never exceed four. HTTP fixture server processes and active phases after shutdown are zero. Handler factory invocations are not connection counts.
comparison_note: The baseline rejects nonempty failed-source batches before any provider request. The current optional-Root path continues with an explicit terminal failure. Do not compute a latency speedup for a missing baseline request. Historical cached/grace head measurements are superseded.
